summary: Tested backend + frontend for the MEMBER quick reconnect feature. Backend endpoint POST /api/auth/login correctly returns user.accessToken for MEMBER role and accepts login by accessToken without password. Frontend login screen displays the 'Bon retour !' quick reconnect card with 'Se reconnecter' and 'Utiliser un autre compte' buttons when canQuickReconnect is true (simulated via localStorage). Kotiz header with icon and title renders correctly. Full quick reconnect click flow successfully authenticates MEMBER and redirects to /(tabs). Decline flow clears state and shows the classic login form. All 5 requested features are functional.

ui_bugs.issue: The developer used HTML attribute `data-testid` on TouchableOpacity. React Native Web only forwards the `testID` prop to `data-testid`. As a result the current `data-testid` attributes are dropped and not present in the DOM. Automation had to fallback to text selectors. Replace `data-testid="quick-reconnect-btn"` and `data-testid="use-other-account-btn"` with `testID="quick-reconnect-btn"` and `testID="use-other-account-btn"`.

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Replace `data-testid` with `testID` on the two TouchableOpacity buttons in /app/frontend/app/login.js (lines 334 and 349) so React Native Web actually renders `data-testid` in the DOM for future automation.
critical_code_review_comments: login.js is now ~1044 lines; consider splitting the QuickReconnect card into its own component for maintainability.

In backend/routes/auth.js login response, `accessToken: user.role === 'MEMBER' ? user.token : undefined` will still serialize the key with value null in some JSON serializers if user.token is null; explicit conditional include is safer but current behavior is acceptable.

Frontend AuthContext.loadUser: even when a valid authToken exists but the JWT has expired server-side, canQuickReconnect stays false. Consider triggering canQuickReconnect on a 401 response interceptor so a real expiration seamlessly leads to the reconnect screen (current implementation only kicks in when no authToken/user is stored).
